name: Dazzling Light (Recharge 5–6)
description: Magical, colored light springs from the creature in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
